race.comment: DRAW ATTENTION (2) is a former Victorian who has been right there in both local runs to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Strips fitter third-up from the break and gets the services of Melbourne Cup winning hoop Dolan in the saddle. Rates the testing material against this line-up. MAD ANA (5) has placed over this course and distance and will be rock-hard fit for this. Has her share of ability and is a definite top-three prospect. SWEET PRETENDER (10) didn't have the best of luck last time out but the form prior was good enough for a race of this nature. Watch for a spike in form. CLUBMAN (4) ran an improved race finishing midfield last start at this track on a soft track. Looks suited and worth including.
